content.comment_body: Hello everyone, does [product_name] [article_no] have a battery, and is there any retentive memory area available?

Hi, [product_name] [article_no] is equipped with retentive memory. However, based on the manuals, there is no indication of a battery slot or internal battery. For more information, refer to section 3.9 in the following document: [url]. Hope this clarifies things.
Thank you. So, it is possible to store parameters in the retentive memory, and after a power cycle, the values will remain unchanged from before the power loss.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants clarified that [product_name] [article_no] devices support retentive memory for storing parameters but do not include a battery or battery slot. The discussion highlighted uncertainties about product documentation relating to memory retention during power loss.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the device to preserve parameter values after a power loss, preferably through retentive memory within the hardware or via some form of backup.
